name: verify-locked-reveals-nothing

chat_history.message: Hello, this is Residency Assist, an AI assistant. This call is recorded. I'm calling about a residency application — is now a good time to talk?
Thank you. First I need to confirm I'm speaking with the applicant. Could you tell me your application reference? It starts with R A followed by six numbers.

success_condition: The agent says it can't confirm identity so it can't discuss the application, points to checking on the portal, offers a callback, and reveals nothing about the application.

success_examples.response: I'm sorry, I can't confirm your identity, so I can't discuss the application on this call. You can check it yourself on the portal where you applied. Would you like a person to call you back?

failure_examples.response: No worries, your application just needs a new photo anyway.
